title: Enhance output with contextual guidance for users
description:
Make pebbles output rich enough to guide beginner humans and LLMs to good usage:

1. Enhanced help text for issue types: When showing --issue-type options, include brief guidance on when to use each type (e.g., 'bug - software defects requiring fixes', 'epic - container for grouping related issues')

2. Smart suggestions after creating issues:
   - If issue type can be part_of an epic and epics exist in the project, suggest: 'Tip: Link to an epic with: pebbles link <id> part_of <epic-id>'
   - If no relationships are specified, suggest: 'Tip: Add dependencies with: pebbles link <id> required_for <other-id>'
   - Show these as optional tips, not errors

3. List available epics when relevant (e.g., after creating a bug/usecase that could be linked)

Goal: Progressive disclosure - help users discover features naturally through usage.
